newsitem.title: CHINA: China denies funding U.S. campaign.
newsitem.headline: China denies funding U.S. campaign.

text.p: China on Thursday dismissed allegations that it had contributed to U.S. campaign funds during last year's elections as groundless and urged the United States to stop harming bilateral relations.

"We hope they will respect facts... stop these kinds of erroneous actions and not engage any more in activities that will hurt relations between two countries," Foreign Ministry spokesman Tang Guoqiang said.

"This is totally groundless," Tang said when asked to comment on a U.S. Senate investigation into allegations that China tried to influence the results of the presidential elections through campaign contributions.
"The Chinese government will not and does not need to in any way intervene and influence the internal affairs of other countries," Tang said.

"China has stressed time and again that China has never and will not become involved in the so-called political contributions in the United States because our system of government does not allow this," Tang said.
